court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
case_name: Sulphur Mills Limited (Applicant) vs Shivalik Crop Science Private Limited

parties.respondent_defendant: Shivalik Crop Science Pvt Ltd, Defendant

facts_of_case: The plaintiff Sulphur Mills Ltd claims trademark infringement and passing off by the defendant Shivalik Crop Science Pvt Ltd. The plaintiff manufactures and sells crop protection agrochemicals including fertilizers, pesticides, insecticides, fungicides, herbicides etc. The mark in question is Metalman which has been used by the plaintiff since 2006.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party claiming infringement to prove that the mark is identical.
legal_principles.held: It is, therefore, made absolute. The cause of action in passing off is thus permitted to be combined with the cause of action in infringement.

legal_principles.principle: A trade mark is identical if it is substantially similar to the registered mark.
legal_principles.held: The mark in question is Metalman. It has been used by the Plaintiffs since 2006.

outcome.final_order: The cause of action in passing off is thus permitted to be combined with the cause of action in infringement. The mark Metalman is made absolute.
